name: Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY)
description: Comprehensive cashless health insurance coverage up to ₹5 Lakh per year per family for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation. Senior citizens aged 70+ get an exclusive separate ₹5 Lakh top-up cover via the Ayushman Vaya Vandana Card.
subsidy_info: 100% cashless treatment at all empaneled public and private hospitals across India.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: Guaranteed monthly pension ranging from ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 post-60 years of age based on contribution amount, backed by Government of India.
subsidy_info: Government co-contribution for eligible subscribers. Subscriber receives life-long assured pension.

name: PM Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)
description: Old age protection and social security scheme for unorganized workers. Assures a minimum monthly pension of ₹3,000 after attaining age 60 with 50:50 government matching contribution.
subsidy_info: 50% monthly contribution matched by Central Government into beneficiary pension account.

name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
description: Solar rooftop subsidy scheme providing up to 300 units of free electricity per month. Central financial assistance: ₹30,000 for 1 kW, ₹60,000 for 2 kW, and up to ₹78,000 for 3 kW or higher systems.
required_documents: Proof of Roof Ownership / Property Tax
subsidy_info: Direct DBT subsidy into bank account: ₹30k (1 kW), ₹60k (2 kW), ₹78k (3 kW+). Concessional collateral-free bank loans available.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY 2.0)
description: Housing for All initiative providing interest subsidy up to ₹2.30 Lakh to ₹2.67 Lakh on home loans for EWS, LIG, and MIG families to purchase or construct their first pucca house.
required_documents: Affidavit stating no pucca house ownership anywhere in India
subsidy_info: Upfront interest subsidy credited directly to beneficiary loan account reducing principal and EMI.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
description: Provides free deposit-free LPG connection to adult women from BPL and disadvantaged households, along with a targeted subsidy of ₹300 per refill for up to 12 cylinders annually.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of applicant & family members
subsidy_info: Free stove + first cylinder connection deposit waiver + ₹300 subsidy per refill directly in bank account.

name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
description: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 directly transferred into the bank accounts of all landholding farmer families across India.
subsidy_info: 100% direct central government cash transfer via Aadhaar-linked DBT.

name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
description: Comprehensive empowerment for 18 traditional artisan trades (carpenters, blacksmiths, goldsmiths, potters, etc.). Offers ₹15,000 modern toolkit e-voucher grant, ₹500/day training stipend, and collateral-free enterprise loans up to ₹3 Lakh at an ultra-low 5% interest rate.
subsidy_info: ₹15,000 toolkit grant + 8% interest subvention by Government ensuring effective interest rate is capped at just 5%.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
description: Loans up to ₹10 Lakh without collateral for micro and small enterprises across three stages: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishor (₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakh), and Tarun (₹5 Lakh to ₹10 Lakh).
required_documents: Bank Statements for the last 6 months
subsidy_info: No collateral or third-party guarantee required. Credit guarantee backed by CGFMU.

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
description: Bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore for Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), and/or Women entrepreneurs to set up greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services, agri-allied, or trading.
subsidy_info: Up to 25% margin money can be converged with central or state subsidy schemes.

name: NSFDC Micro Finance Scheme (MFS)
description: Micro Finance Scheme for small-scale income generating activities exclusively for SC individuals. Project cost up to ₹1.40 Lakh with 90% loan assistance (max ₹1.25 Lakh) at 6.5% p.a. concessional rate.
subsidy_info: Statutory 90% loan assistance up to ₹1.25 Lakh. Quarterly repayment over 3 years with 3-month moratorium.

name: NSFDC Term Loan Scheme
description: Concessional term loan for income-generating activities costing from ₹1.40 Lakh up to ₹50.00 Lakh for SC entrepreneurs. Maximum loan assistance up to 90% of project cost (up to ₹45.00 Lakh) at 8.0% p.a.
subsidy_info: 90% project cost financing. Quarterly repayment over 7 years with 6-month moratorium (up to 12 months for plantation/construction).

name: NSFDC Aajeevika Micro-Finance Yojana
description: Micro finance credit assistance through Channel Partners and NBFC-MFIs for quick livelihood activities. Project cost up to ₹1.40 Lakh with loan assistance up to ₹1.25 Lakh at 15.0% p.a.
subsidy_info: Fast-track processing for immediate micro-livelihoods via empaneled NBFC-MFIs and SCAs.

name: NSFDC Udyam Nidhi Yojana (UNY)
description: Composite loan assistance for setting up micro-enterprises with project cost up to ₹5.00 Lakh. Maximum loan ₹4.50 Lakh at 13.0% (Co-operative Banks) to 15.0% (Small Finance Banks).
subsidy_info: Repayment over 5 years in quarterly or half-yearly installments with a 3-month moratorium period.

name: NSFDC Educational Loan Scheme (India)
description: Concessional education loan for SC students pursuing recognized full-time professional/technical courses in India. Up to ₹40.00 Lakh (90% of course fee) at 6.0% p.a. Special 0.5% interest rebate for female students (5.5% p.a.).
subsidy_info: Female beneficiaries receive an exclusive 0.5% interest rebate (effective 5.5% p.a.). Moratorium covers full course duration + 1 year.

name: NSFDC Educational Loan Scheme (Abroad)
description: Concessional education loan for SC students pursuing professional/technical higher education in approved institutions abroad. Up to ₹40.00 Lakh at 7.0% p.a. (6.5% p.a. for female students).
subsidy_info: Repayment tenure up to 12 years with course duration + 1 year moratorium. 0.5% rebate for women.

name: PMEGP (Prime Minister's Employment Generation)
description: Credit-linked subsidy programme for setting up new micro-enterprises in manufacturing (up to ₹50 Lakh) or service sector (up to ₹20 Lakh). Provides heavy government capital subsidy on project cost.
subsidy_info: SC/ST/Women/OBC: 35% capital subsidy in rural areas, 25% in urban areas. General: 25% rural, 15% urban.
